t-O-Qdh7VvQ.text: Well, that very nearly is the method of power generation. It would presumably be paired with some sort of Dyson sphere around the white dwarf. You may also enjoy: [VIDEO] which is a minutephysics on black hole power using much the same principles but attaining yet higher efficiencies.
